unit.why: A short introduction to the tsaddik's holy spirit followed by one anecdote: he answered R' Emanuel's unspoken question about drinking wine.

stories.start_quote: נודע ג״כ כי היה בעל רוה"ק גדול
stories.summary_en: R' Emanuel of Przedbórz came to the rebbe in Mogielnica meaning to ask him privately whether he should drink wine; at the Friday-night meal wine was unusually set on the table, and the rebbe gave him wine and answered his whole question explicitly, as if he had asked.

quotes: נודע ג״כ כי היה בעל רוה"ק גדול
ואמר לו כל התשובה בפירוש כאלו היה שואל אותו
tags.why: The rebbe knows the unspoken question through ruach ha-kodesh.

quotes: אם ישתה יין כי היה לו איזה ענין ספק
tags.why: Drinking wine is the subject of the question and of the rebbe's act.

quotes: פ״א בא למאגלניצא והיה בדעתו לשאול אותו
tags.why: The disciple travels to the rebbe's court to bring a question.

quotes: ובסעודת ע״ש לא היו רגילים להעמיד יין
tags.why: The scene is the Friday-night meal.

quotes: מהה״צ ר׳ עמנואל ז״ל מפרשעדבורז תלמיד מרן ז״ל
tags.why: The disciple seeks his master's guidance.

quotes: סיפר הרב החסיד ר׳ מאטיל הרב דגאוורטשוב
tags.why: The tale is framed as passed on by named hasidim.
The action takes place at the rebbe's table with his hasidim at court.
The story is offered as an example of the rebbe's great holy spirit.
